definitions.gloss: closer; relief pitcher who finishes the game (baseball)
definitions.explanation: A relief pitcher brought in to protect a narrow lead and record the final outs, usually in the ninth inning; an English loanword.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧クローザーだ。
クローザー⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{九回|きゅうかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}えた→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧。
examples.english: The closer shut down the ninth inning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{信頼|しんらい}できる→信頼する：22988_shinraisuru⟧クローザー⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{有利|ゆうり}→有利：03651_yuuri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進|すす}められる→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: Having a reliable closer lets you play the game to your advantage.

notes:
An English loanword for the relief pitcher who finishes a close game. The native equivalent is ⟦{抑|おさ}え→抑え：30004_osae⟧ or ⟦{抑|おさ}え→抑え：30004_osae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{投手|とうしゅ}→投手：06563_toushu⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{抑|おさ}え→抑え：30004_osae⟧: closer — the native Japanese term for the same role
- ⟦{中継|なかつ}ぎ→中継ぎ：30003_nakatsugi⟧: middle reliever — pitches the middle innings before the closer
